header: W2 (AC1 section 5): the verifier's labelled dev set, read by helper/scripts/verifier-eval.ts.

Each case is a field (as fill/contract.ts FieldContract reads it), a text Caret would type, where the text was read (Provenance), and a human label: expected 'right' when the text is exactly the field's value, 'wrong' otherwise, with the category ('label') a reader would pick. The labels were read case by case, not taken from an answer key's string.

Seeded from: the guard adversary's dump at W2 step 3 (scripts/guard-adversary.ts --dump-proposed): canned key values ('canned-key', right), class (a) values that hold a key's value and more, and class (b) note values for a field whose key is none (both wrong); LV1's three live wrongs (ids note 'lv1-'); and every REVIEW-R2 case.

All text is synthetic fixture text. Jev's verdicts on this set are evidence for reading, never training data (TypeSafe terms §2.3(b)): verifier-eval.ts writes them to an evidence folder, and nothing here trains or tunes on them without a person reading them.
Tune the verifier's wording on this set only; the held-out pages (evidence/screen/heldout) are read once per candidate wording.
